item: R792 part B (row 315): the uninstall watcher says when another program still had the database open
summary: The secure-uninstall watcher keeps each SQLite store file it erases, checks once without waiting for another holder via F_GETLK, rescrubs within 2 s while one is seen, and logs one of three lines (may be incomplete / could not check / none seen with the lock-less caveat); never signals another process, never logs pid or path; Help x12 names the log and the limit. Loop-writer: before 5/5 salt and a silent log, after 0/5 salt and 5/5 INCOMPLETE.
